solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Guesthouse owner with son in outskirts of Londonderry?

indicators.note: in places the middle pieces inside the letters on either side
the outskirts of a word are its first and last letters

parts.note: with and and both join one thing to another
a son is a lad, a boy

explanation.surface: A B&B keeper living on the edge of the Northern Irish city with her boy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Londonderry' hints at a LAND word, but only its outer letters L and Y are used, holding AND and LAD.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman who runs a lodging house or boarding house and takes in paying guests is its landlady.

clue.text: Murdered at night? It's a mere guess

definitions.meaning: a victim gunned down after dark was literally hit by a bullet in darkness
an idiom for a wild attempt made with no real knowledge

explanation.surface: A detective sneers that a theory about a nocturnal killing is pure speculation.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes a guess made blindly, like firing a gun without seeing a target.

clue.text: Cowardly bird at foot of cape

indicators.note: in a down clue the second piece sits below the first, at its foot

parts.note: C is the map abbreviation for cape
a raven is a large black bird of the crow family

explanation.surface: A timid seabird cowers at the bottom of a headland.
explanation.definitionFit: Craven is a literary synonym for lacking courage, spinelessly fearful.

clue.text: Reportedly writes critiques of stage shows

indicators.note: reportedly signals that the word is heard as spoken, not as spelt

parts.note: someone who writes critiques reviews things

explanation.surface: A theatre critic is said to pen pieces on the latest productions.
explanation.definitionFit: A revue is a light theatrical entertainment of sketches, songs and dances, so revues are stage shows.

clue.text: Nursery rhyme character, tearing bib, let out yell

indicators.note: tearing the words apart rips their letters into a new order

explanation.surface: A toddler rips his bib and lets out a scream.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tearing' looks like a verb about the bib, but it signals that BIB LET OUT YELL is rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: In the traditional rhyme, the boy who should blow his horn is found asleep under the haystack.

clue.text: Old blokes writing on the wall?

parts.note: blokes is British slang for men

explanation.surface: Old men scrawling graffiti on a wall.
explanation.walkthrough: 'writing on the wall' is the biblical phrase (Daniel) for a sign of coming doom, hence the question mark.
explanation.definitionFit: The writing on the wall is an idiom for a portent of disaster, which is what a bad sign foretells.

clue.text: Articles framed by Republicans? I'll say!

indicators.note: framed by means surrounded on both sides by the next piece

parts.note: R is the abbreviation for Republican, so two of them give RR
a and the are the indefinite and definite articles

explanation.surface: An exasperated remark about grammar words boxed in by American politicians.
explanation.definitionFit: As an exclamation it is an emphatic yes, a dated British way of agreeing strongly.

clue.text: Unhappily imagine being short of one puzzle

indicators.note: unhappily suggests the letters are in a bad state and must be rearranged
being short of means lacking something, so a letter is taken away

parts.note: one is I, the Roman numeral

explanation.surface: Someone gloomily pictures being one piece short of finishing a jigsaw.
explanation.walkthrough: 'being short of' removes one I from IMAGINE, leaving MAGINE; 'Unhappily' rearranges that.
explanation.definitionFit: An enigma is something mysterious or baffling, a riddle that is hard to understand.

clue.text: Time to go back and prepare for publication

indicators.note: going back means the word is read backwards

parts.note: tide is an old word for time, as in Christmastide

explanation.surface: An editor says it is time to return to the manuscript before printing.
explanation.definitionFit: Editing is correcting and revising text so it is ready to be printed.

clue.text: Jumping over arched structure in roof

definitions.meaning: leaping across something, as a gymnast does a horse
the arched ceiling work of a church or cellar

explanation.surface: Someone leaps across the arched beams of a cathedral roof.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both clearing an obstacle with a leap and a series of vaults forming a ceiling.

clue.text: Income distributed in Angers

indicators.note: distributed means spread around, so the letters are scattered into a new order

explanation.surface: Money handed out in the French city of Angers.
explanation.definitionFit: Earnings are the money a person receives for work, their wages or income.

clue.text: Initially grill a river fish

indicators.note: initially means take the first letter of each of the following words

explanation.surface: A cooking instruction: first put a freshwater fish under the grill.
explanation.walkthrough: 'river fish' looks like the definition, but 'river' supplies its first letter and 'fish' alone defines.
explanation.definitionFit: The gar is a long-snouted fish, also called the garfish or needlefish.

clue.text: Catch sight of English agent

parts.note: a secret agent is a spy

explanation.surface: Glimpsing a British secret agent in the field.
explanation.definitionFit: To espy is a literary verb meaning to notice or spot something at a distance.

clue.text: Sanctimonious about minister's former convictions

indicators.note: about means going around the next piece

parts.note: pious can mean making a show of virtue, sanctimonious
Rev, short for Reverend, is a minister's title

explanation.surface: A self-righteous clergyman is revealed to have a criminal record.
explanation.walkthrough: In British slang a person who 'has previous' has a criminal record; this noun sense fits 'former convictions'.
explanation.definitionFit: Police slang uses the word as a noun for a history of earlier offences, a criminal record.

clue.text: Legend presented in crummy theatre

indicators.note: presented in means the letters are shown inside the following words

explanation.surface: An old tale staged in a run-down playhouse.
explanation.definitionFit: A myth is a traditional story of heroes or gods, much like a legend.

clue.text: One popping the question for model?

parts.note: pro means in favour of, for
a poser is one who poses, as a model does

explanation.surface: A suitor proposes marriage to a fashion model.
explanation.walkthrough: To pop the question is to make an offer of marriage.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who makes a marriage offer, or puts forward a motion, is one who proposes.

clue.text: Pair admitting strong affection for shore bird

indicators.note: admitting means letting something in, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: love is strong affection

explanation.surface: A couple of seabirds confess their devotion on the beach.
explanation.definitionFit: Plovers are short-billed wading birds found on beaches and mudflats.

clue.text: Narcotic drug I consumed after work

indicators.note: after places the first-named pieces behind the next one

parts.note: op, short for opus, is a musical work
ate means consumed

explanation.surface: Someone confesses to taking painkillers after a shift.
explanation.definitionFit: An opiate is a drug derived from opium, such as morphine, that dulls pain and induces sleep.

clue.text: Sort of restaurant, one with yellowy-brown entrance

parts.note: tan is a yellowish-brown colour
a door is an entrance
one is I, the Roman numeral

explanation.surface: A single eatery with a beige front door.
explanation.walkthrough: The pieces appear in the order one, colour, entrance, but are assembled as colour, entrance, one.
explanation.definitionFit: Tandoori restaurants serve Indian food cooked in a clay oven called a tandoor.

clue.text: Woman entertaining love for unidentified writer

indicators.note: entertaining means hosting a guest, so one piece takes the other in

parts.note: Ann is a woman's name
love is zero in tennis, written O

explanation.surface: A woman hosting a lover for a mysterious author.
explanation.definitionFit: Anon, short for anonymous, is printed where the author of a work is not known.

clue.text: Liveliness one found in little sibling?

indicators.note: found in means placed inside the next piece

parts.note: bro is a short, informal word for brother
one is I, the Roman numeral

explanation.surface: Energy is what you find in a kid brother.
explanation.walkthrough: 'little' signals a shortened word, not a younger child.
explanation.definitionFit: Brio is vigour or vivacity, especially in performance.

clue.text: Husky ambassador carrying rowing equipment

indicators.note: carrying means holding something within, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: HE stands for His or Her Excellency, the title of an ambassador
oars are what you row with

explanation.surface: A diplomat's sled dog hauls a set of oars.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Husky' looks like the dog; it means rough-voiced.
explanation.definitionFit: A husky voice is low and rough, just as a hoarse one is.

clue.text: Bull left us with lacerations, by the sound of it

indicators.note: by the sound of it means the word is heard spoken, not as spelt

parts.note: something that tore us left us cut and torn

explanation.surface: A charging bull has gashed the victims, it seems.
explanation.definitionFit: Taurus is the zodiac sign and constellation whose symbol is the bull.
